page_title: HAV 3-2 NAN | Le Havre v Nantes 30/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) gets a yellow card.
90+1' Substitution. Johann Lepenant leaves the pitch and is replaced by Meschack Elia (Nantes).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' 3 - 2 Goal! 3:2. Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

88' Koka (Le Havre) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Anthony Lopes, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
87' Le Havre are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
85' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Nantes are awarded the free kick.
84' The substitution is prepared. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Abdoulaye Toure.

83' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Eric Wattellier blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Nantes have been awarded a free kick.
82' The game is interrupted now, Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
80' Referee Eric Wattellier sees the trip by Kelvin Amian (Nantes) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Le Havre in a dangerous position.
79' Mostafa Mohamed goes off the pitch and Louis Leroux (Nantes) comes on.
78' The linesman points to the corner flag, Le Havre are going to take it.
75' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) gets to a rebound in the six-yard box and his effort smashes off the crossbar.
73' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Issa Soumare and he is replaced by Koka (Le Havre).
73' It's time for a substitution. Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) comes on in place of Yassine Kechta.
71' Eric Wattellier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Yassine Kechta (Le Havre). That's a free kick to Nantes.
69' Corner kick. Le Havre will have an opportunity.
67' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
66' Moses Simon (Nantes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.
64' Today's referee Eric Wattellier rightly decides to book Sorba Thomas (Nantes) for his harsh tackle.
62' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) replacing Arouna Sangante.
62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre) for Andre Ayew.
59' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
58' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
54' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

52' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Nantes win a corner.
51' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Nantes will take a free kick near the side line.
51' Referee Eric Wattellier points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Nantes players celebrate.
49' The Nantes players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
48' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Matthis Abline plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Moses Simon (Nantes). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:2.

47' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
46' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Nantes.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 6:5.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) comes onto the pitch because Pedro Chirivella simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
43' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

39' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Anthony Lopes to get hold of the ball.
38' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
37' The game is interrupted now, Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Nantes.
34' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
29' The Le Havre players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
27' 2 - 1 Goal! Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Anthony Lopes to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
27' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
26' Saidou Sow (Nantes) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Eric Wattellier saw the whole situation. Le Havre have been awarded a penalty kick!
23' 1 - 1 Goal! Nicolas Pallois gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Saidou Sow (Nantes) climbs highest and powers a close-range header inside the right post. 1:1.
22' The corner kick from Moses Simon (Nantes) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

22' Moses Simon (Nantes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Nantes force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

19' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His almost perfect header hits the bar and ricochets away off it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
18' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Timothee Pembele (Le Havre), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
16' Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
13' 1 - 0 Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) smoothly converts the penalty with a beautiful low drive into the right side of the goal.
13' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is going to take the penalty!

12' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Saidou Sow (Nantes). The referee gives a penalty to Le Havre after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
10' Neat passing move from Le Havre in order to create new attacking opportunities.
6' A pass from Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is intercepted by Anthony Lopes and the move breaks down.
4' Great teamplay by Le Havre as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Nantes will kick the game off.
Eric Wattellier will officiate today.
